peerMapping.justification: The block pairs Apple with the Nasdaq-100 as the single index hedge because Apple's earnings sensitivity is dominated by mega-cap technology and consumer digital ecosystems, which the Nasdaq-100 captures more directly than the broader S&P 500 or the narrower semiconductor and country ETFs. The seven single-name peers are the most economically comparable mega-cap platform and device businesses in the provided universe. Weights are positive and sum to exactly 1, and the assignment leans on both business similarity and the displayed 24-hour perp liquidity figures, which are stated in USD millions. Microsoft's displayed liquidity of 1.386 24-hour perp liquidity in USD millions and Nvidia's at 3.384 USD millions are in line with Apple's own 1.422 USD millions, while Alphabet at 2.262 USD millions and Samsung common shares at 2.55 USD millions provide the deepest displayed availability among the chosen names, supporting their meaningful weights.

peers.name: Microsoft
peers.reason: Closest large-cap software and services match with premium margins and ecosystem lock-in; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 1.386 USD millions, close to AAPL at 1.422 USD millions.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.reason: Alphabet provides comparable global platform economics across mobile services, advertising, cloud, and AI, making it a strong economic match; displayed 24-hour liquidity is 2.262 USD millions.

peers.name: Meta Platforms
peers.reason: Meta adds consumer platform scale and high-margin digital services exposure, helping represent the services side of Apple’s ecosystem; displayed 24-hour liquidity is 1.343 USD millions.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: Captures accelerated-computing and AI hardware factor sensitivity that now drives megacap technology returns; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 3.384 USD millions.

peers.name: Amazon
peers.reason: Mega-cap hardware and platform company exposed to the same consumer device and cloud ecosystem cycle as Apple; displayed liquidity of 0.462 USD millions is thinner, so it gets a smaller but still material weight.

peers.name: Samsung Electronics common
peers.reason: Direct smartphone and consumer-electronics comparator with memory and handset-cycle exposure; displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.55 USD millions.

peers.name: Tesla
peers.reason: Tesla is included only as a smaller innovation-weighted consumer hardware peer with brand strength and ecosystem optionality, while its higher displayed liquidity of 4.551 USD millions is capped by weaker comparability to Apple’s core margins.

primary_index_hedge.name: Nasdaq-100
primary_index_hedge.reason: Apple is one of the largest weights in the Nasdaq-100, so this index hedge tracks the stock's dominant mega-cap technology beta better than a broader or more specialized index or ETF. Its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 21.944 USD millions, which is deep enough for practical hedging while preserving the technology concentration that matches Apple.

peerMapping.historyMethod: static initial Kimi weights applied to peer gross-total-return factors; peer closes forward-filled only across asynchronous exchange holidays; basket rebased to the target spot total-return level at the first fully covered date

earningsOptions.source: consolidated listed-options chain, verified earnings calendars, and split-adjusted price history

liquidityFilter.sides: OTM puts below spot and OTM calls above spot

model.name: liquid vertical-spread risk-neutral CDF
model.description: Liquid vertical spreads are used when the chain supplies at least four valid probability points; otherwise the nearest liquid ATM straddle supplies the expiration distribution. Earnings-date log distances are time-scaled from the first post-event expiration.
model.measure: risk-neutral, not a historical or physical forecast

historicalAnalysis.eventSource: SEC earnings release history with verified calendar fallback
historicalAnalysis.method: Each current two-leg structure is translated into percentage-of-spot strikes and debit. Those same normalized strikes and today's debit percentage are replayed across prior earnings using the same calendar-day entry lead and post-event exit horizon. A profitable event requires expiration payoff greater than the original debit.
historicalAnalysis.limitation: Stock-path proxy using today's premium; historical option quotes, bid-ask execution, volatility repricing, early exercise, dividends, and transaction costs are not reconstructed.
